name: Dart
description: Dart is the language behind Flutter, Googles cross-platform UI framework. It is optimized for building fast mobile, web, and desktop apps with a single codebase. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Dart Language Tour (Official)
items.description: The official introduction to Dart covering variables, types, functions, collections, async, and modern Dart 3 features.

items.title: Flutter Learn Pathway
items.description: Google official starting point teaching Dart and Flutter from setup to building functional cross-platform apps.

items.title: Dart Documentation
items.description: Complete official Dart documentation covering library tour, language evolution, and tooling.

items.title: Flutter Codelabs
items.description: Hands-on step-by-step tutorials by Google engineers teaching UI, state management, and clean architecture.

items.title: DartPad
items.description: Google official zero-setup online sandbox to write and execute Dart and Flutter code in-browser.

items.title: Hello Dart (Code Makery)
items.description: A playful interactive tutorial teaching Dart fundamentals through visual quests and coding challenges.

items.title: Google Codelab — Dart Patterns & Records
items.description: Official hands-on guide teaching Dart 3 features — records, pattern matching, destructuring, and switch expressions.

items.title: Flutter Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Massive full-length video taking beginners from zero to publishing on Google Play and App Store.

items.title: Flutter & Firebase Full Stack Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Project-based course covering responsive UI, authentication, database management, and social features.

items.title: Exercism — Dart Track
items.description: 100+ coding exercises with automated analysis and human mentor feedback for writing idiomatic Dart.

items.title: Codewars — Dart Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in Dart across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: Dart Quick Reference (QuickRef)
items.description: Clean comprehensive cheat sheet covering variables, types, collections, OOP, futures, and async/await.

items.title: Dart API Reference
items.description: Complete API documentation for the Dart SDK with all core libraries and packages.

items.title: Flutter & Dart Announcements
items.description: Official Flutter blog covering releases, breaking changes, and ecosystem news.

items.title: This Week in Flutter
items.description: Weekly curated roundup of Flutter and Dart news, packages, and community highlights.

items.title: Reddit r/FlutterDev
items.description: The largest Flutter and Dart community for architecture advice, troubleshooting, and package showcases.

items.title: Flutter Discord
items.description: Active real-time chat with 70k+ members for help channels, project feedback, and job discussions.

items.title: Dart & Flutter Dev (Official)
items.description: Official Dart community page listing groups, events, and contribution guidelines.
